points.quote: They live next to the source, in `src/vs/*/test/` folders (for example `src/vs/workbench/.../test/`).
Locally, run `scripts/test.sh` (`scripts\test.bat` on Windows). It runs them in Electron, and `--run <file>` or `--grep` narrows the run.
`npm run test-node` runs the Node-only unit tests through mocha (`test/unit/node/index.js`). `npm run test-browser` (or `test-browser-no-install`) runs the browser unit tests through Playwright
They live in `test/integration/`. Run `scripts/test-integration.sh` (`.bat` on Windows) to run them.
The built-in extensions have their own tests, and `extensions/vscode-api-tests` tests the extension API. ... The integration scripts also run them.
They live in `test/smoke/`. They drive the real app UI end to end. Run `npm run smoketest`, which compiles first. ... `test/automation` holds the automation driver the smoke tests use.
The runners and infrastructure are in `test/unit/`. ... They live in `test/integration/`. ... They live in `test/smoke/`. ... `test/sanity` holds sanity tests.
